name: @wireio/ql-tool-app
description: WIRE QL desktop workbench: an Electron GUI for the node query engine (query_engine_plugin)

scripts.dev: pnpm run setup:electron && webpack --mode development --config etc/webpack/webpack.config.mjs --config-name main --config-name preload --config-name query-host && webpack serve --mode development --config etc/webpack/webpack.config.mjs --config-name renderer
scripts.start: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && ./scripts/electron/start-electron.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && playwright test --config etc/playwright/playwright.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && electron-builder --config etc/electron-builder/electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && electron-builder --config etc/electron-builder/electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && electron-builder --config etc/electron-builder/electron-builder.config.cjs --linux
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && electron-builder --config etc/electron-builder/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.package:win: pnpm run setup:electron && pnpm run build:webpack && electron-builder --config etc/electron-builder/electron-builder.config.cjs --win
